user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to navigate to the HTTP status code pages so that I can view the page corresponding to different status codes. Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click on the '200' link, I am taken to the URL that contains 'status_codes/200'.
2. When I click on the '404' link, I am taken to the URL that contains 'status_codes/404'.
